title: Prosecution flags use of Santiago, Corona clips by defense in impeachment trial
summary: Prosecution flags use of Santiago, Corona clips by defense in impeachment trial

blocks.text: The House prosecution panel on Thursday flagged Vice President Sara Duterte's defense team for its use of video clips of the late senator Miriam Defensor-Santiago and former Chief Justice Renato Corona during the impeachment trial.
"I think it's already a bad taste to present the video clips of the late senator Miriam Defensor Santiago and the late CJ Corona," said Lanao del Sur lawmaker Zia Alonto Adiong in a press briefing.

"It's also an issue of ethical question. To us, it is unethical to present video clips of those who have already departed. Their supposed statements have nothing to do with the current impeachment trial of the Vice President Sara Duterte," he added.
During the 44th day of the impeachment trial against the vice president, the defense team presented video clips of Santiago and Corona during the latter's impeachment trial in 2012.
However, several senator-judges also questioned the relevance of presenting such video clips from the past.
Moreover, the prosecution panel said that the defense team do not have enough evidence to present.

"Parang nakita po natin na parang wala silang maipresentang ebidensya para i-weaken ang kaso ng prosecution. Ang ginagawa lang po nila sa ngayon ay appeal to sympathy tapos nagawa nilang kunin ang video clips ng mga namayapa na," Adiong further said.

(It seems we've seen that they have no evidence to present to weaken the prosecution's case. Right now, all they're doing is appealing to sympathy, and they even managed to use video clips of those who have already passed away.)

The second week of the presentation of evidence of the defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte is expected to feature four witnesses who will testify on the status of Cale88 Foods Corporation, a declared asset of the Vice President’s husband, Atty. Manases Carpio. —VAL, GMA News
